summary: Reads the node pointer stored at this+0x204 (this[129]), loads the byte at offset +0x14 (20) of that node, masks it with 0x40, and returns bit 6 shifted down, i.e. a 0/1 boolean. Called by sub_40FE50 and SceneExtentComputation (0x004BDC10) during scene extent work to query a node property flag.

operations.description: Load the linked node pointer held at this[129] (this+0x204).
Read the byte at offset +0x14 (20) of the pointed-to node and mask it with 0x40 (bit 6).
Shift the masked bit right by 6, returning a 0 or 1 boolean.
